high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website sustainability-times.com, dated 1:31 PM. The title of the article reads "Qubits Flying Over Long Island Sound." The content of the article discusses the ambitious and captivating vision of sending qubits—fundamental units of quantum information—over Long Island Sound. This endeavor is noted for sparking public interest in quantum sciences and highlighting the unique geographical advantages of the project. The collaboration mentioned involves Yale University, Stony Brook University, and Brookhaven National Laboratory.
